chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad and Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, peace be upon them, said:
"Whoever professes corporealism, do not give him anything from the zakat, and do not perform salat (prayer) behind him."

key_terms.بِالْجِسْمِ: the doctrine of corporeality or attributing bodily form
key_terms.خَلْفَهُ: behind him, meaning following him in congregational salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about praying behind someone who believes Allah is a body?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns the belief that attributes corporeality to Allah, treating it as a grave theological deviation. It also gives practical legal and communal consequences: such a person is not to receive zakat and is not to be followed in congregational salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1111 - Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi (as) and Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad (as) said:
"Whoever believes in anthropomorphism (al-jism), do not give them anything from the zakat, and do not pray behind them."
